deploy.preDeployCommand: attempt=1; until php artisan themis:migrate-deploy; do if [ "$attempt" -ge 12 ]; then exit 1; fi; attempt=$((attempt + 1)); sleep 5; done
deploy.startCommand: sh -c '(while true; do php artisan queue:work database --queue=chat-translations --timeout=25 --sleep=3 --max-time=3600 --no-interaction; sleep 2; done) & exec env RAILPACK_SKIP_MIGRATIONS=true /start-container.sh'
